verificadoPor: rebar new — it never asked GitHub, and it never created the remote
porque: An open gate has to be a CHECKED FACT, not an omission. The generator does not create the repository on GitHub and does not install the ruleset: both touch the owner's account. So it writes this record with estado "ausente", which is the honest default — the branch is unprotected until somebody proves the opposite — and `.rebar/portao-remoto.mjs` fails the verify while it stays true. JSON has no comments, so this field is where the reason lives. The `checks` above are a WRITTEN-DOWN COPY of the last derivation: the checker never reads them to decide, it derives the names from .github/workflows/verificar.yml on every run, and testes/portao.test.mjs compares this copy against that workflow with no network, so a renamed matrix goes red here instead of leaving a ruleset that requires a check nobody runs.
